summary: Novita AI for Startups offers up to $10,000 in usage credits across Novita's Model APIs (LLM, image, video, voice) and Agent Sandbox: up to $1,000 upfront, the next $5,000 matched 1:1 (every dollar spent earns a dollar of credit), and the final $4,000 matched 2:1 (every two dollars spent earns one). Credits are redeemable for one year and split up to $5K Agent Sandbox + $5K Model API. The landing lists venture-backed, Series B or earlier, AI-native and new-user criteria. Its linked official application is stricter: pre-seed through early Series B, latest funding round within 12 months, founded within three years, AI central to the product and active sandbox usage in production, and a new Novita user. Final eligibility and credit amount remain at Novita's discretion; confirm any mismatch before relying on the broader landing criteria.
claim_steps: Apply via the Google Form linked from https://startups.novita.ai/ .

Check the linked application: venture-backed pre-seed through early Series B, latest round within 12 months, founded within three years, AI central to the product and active sandbox usage in production, and a new Novita user.
If the broader landing criteria and stricter application differ for your case, ask startups@novita.ai to confirm eligibility. Final eligibility and credit amount are discretionary.
On approval: up to $1K upfront credit, then spend-match to unlock the rest (1:1 up to $5K, then 2:1 up to $4K); redeemable for one year.
